REPO="$HOME/mems26/mems26_web_git" LOG="/tmp/morning_gate.log" exec >> "$LOG" 2>&1 echo "════ morning-gate $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z') ════"
# skip weekends (Sat=6, Sun=0) DOW=$(date +%w) if [ "$DOW" = "0" ] || [ "$DOW" = "6" ]; then echo "weekend — skipping" exit 0 fi
cd "$REPO" || exit 1
# git pull git pull origin stabilize/mems26-local-truth-2026-05-16 2>&1 || true
# flag_guard FG=$(.venv/bin/python3 scripts/flag_guard.py 2>&1) FG_RC=$? echo "$FG" | tail -3
# fire_drill FD=$(.venv/bin/python3 scripts/fire_drill.py 2>&1) FD_RC=$? echo "$FD" | tail -5
if [ "$FG_RC" -ne 0 ] || [ "$FD_RC" -ne 0 ]; then echo "🔴 GATE FAILED — writing to LIVE_CHANNEL" MSG="### [$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M IL')] cc-imac · 🔴 morning-gate FAILED (auto)\n\nflag_guard rc=$FG_RC · fire_drill rc=$FD_RC\n\n---\n\n" # prepend to LIVE_CHANNEL CHAN="$REPO/../../../Downloads/mems26_web_git/docs/handoff/LIVE_CHANNEL.md" if [ -f "$CHAN" ]; then printf "%b" "$MSG" | cat - "$CHAN" > /tmp/lc_tmp && mv /tmp/lc_tmp "$CHAN" cd "$(dirname "$CHAN")/../.." && git add docs/handoff/LIVE_CHANNEL.md && \ git commit -m "cc-imac: morning-gate FAILED (auto)" && \ git push github-mems26:michaelbarg/mems26-web.git stabilize/mems26-local-truth-2026-05-16 || true fi # push alert .venv/bin/python3 -c " from scripts.flag_guard import parse_env import os, urllib.request, urllib.parse for k,v in parse_env('$REPO/.env').items(): os.environ.setdefault(k,v) token=os.getenv('PUSHOVER_API_TOKEN','') user=os.getenv('PUSHOVER_USER_KEY','') if token and user: urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request('https://api.pushover.net/1/messages.json', urllib.parse.urlencode({'token':token,'user':user,'title':'MEMS26 morning-gate FAILED (mac2)', 'message':'flag_guard=$FG_RC fire_drill=$FD_RC','priority':'1','sound':'persistent'}).encode()),timeout=10) " 2>/dev/null || true else echo "✅ GATE PASSED" fi echo "════ done ════"
